'''''The Shafr Anthology of Galactic Language, Second Edition''''' was a [[Book/Legends|publication]] that was released in [[38 ABY]] by [[Shafr Center Press/Legends|The Shafr Center Press]]<ref name="Written" /> of the [[Shafr Center]] academic institution. Those organizations,<ref name="Gamer9">{{GamerCite|9|Race for the Tessent}}</ref> as well as the anthology itself, shared their name with the [[Shafr system/Legends|Shafr system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

''The Shafr Anthology of Galactic Language, Second Edition'' included an article by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Milanda Vorgan]], [[Professor/Legends|Associate Professor of Xenolinguistics]] at the [[University of Charmath]]. The article, titled "[[The Written Word: A Brief Introduction to the Writing Systems of Galactic Basic]]," offered a brief overview of several of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] most prominent [[Writing/Legends|writing systems]] used for the [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] [[Language/Legends|language]].<ref name="Written" />

==Behind the scenes==
''The Shafr Anthology of Galactic Language, Second Edition'' was introduced in the article "[[The Written Word]]," which was authored by [[John Hazlett]] and published on [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] on [[March 5]], [[2010]].<ref name="Written" />
